claim_summaries: FKV 1991 clearly overlaps the critical fluctuation and abnormal-scaling lineage; accessible primary evidence does not settle overlap with whole-state separability, trace-norm rates, preparation, or operational memory results.
The isotropic critical state exp(2 J^2/N) has an exact positive iid-product integral representation for every finite N; its scaled HS field has the quartic exp(-4|x|^4/3) limit.
Standard QLAN applies to iid local product-state families at 1/sqrt(n) scale and does not directly cover the collective critical Gibbs family.
Existing generic long-range high-temperature separability thresholds do not directly cover the target critical inverse temperature.
